nodes.label: startSpring spring integrator
nodes.rationale: Hand-rolled spring over a duration-based transition because it is interruptible and avoids a 30KB animation library given the 180KB first-load budget

nodes.label: weeklyHours/computeOpenStatus
nodes.rationale: Open/closed is computed against the Asia/Kolkata clock, never the machine's

nodes.label: sendWhatsAppText (Business Cloud API)
nodes.rationale: Best-effort: callers must never fail a hold/booking because notify failed

nodes.label: upstashPipeline helper
nodes.rationale: Plain fetch, no SDK, null creds when unconfigured so every route degrades to a logged demo mode

nodes.label: service worker offline shell + catalog cache
nodes.norm_label: service worker offline shell + catalog cache

nodes.label: performance budget guard
nodes.rationale: Per-route chunks never load together, so summing every emitted file would overstate payload; uses union of app-build-manifest chunks per route

nodes.label: safe dev-server restart
nodes.rationale: Wipes .next because colliding servers caused 'reading call' chunk corruption

nodes.label: Unsplash/picsum stock fetch
nodes.rationale: Stand-ins only — replace with real product photography before launch

nodes.label: Digital Showroom Build Plan
nodes.rationale: Resolves spec contradictions (SSG vs server-filtered grid, analytics, hydration-safe save-data gate, FLIP vs Framer Motion, dialog back-button integrity) and records D1-D6 user decisions

nodes.label: Nike-design-analysis
nodes.rationale: Photography-first commerce system: towering uppercase display, pill CTAs, flat product cards on soft-cloud gray, 8px grid; all chromatic energy reserved for photography and sale pricing

nodes.label: RAVYA FASHION README
nodes.rationale: States catalog ships as 29 invented SKUs while sampleCatalog=true and documents zero-config measurement fallback

nodes.label: Master Build Document
nodes.rationale: Single source spec: master prompt, PRD, TRD, UI/UX spec, motion spec, 180KB/2G performance contract, WCAG AA accessibility, folder structure

nodes.label: pnpm workspace config
nodes.rationale: Allows sharp's postinstall build scripts; sharp is a devDependency for the image pipeline only

nodes.label: Brand assets guide
nodes.rationale: Uppercase letter-spaced wordmarks are the default; official SVGs in public/brands/<id>.svg are an optional override

nodes.label: Neo-Editorial Streetwear design system
nodes.rationale: Stitch design system: Syne display + Plus Jakarta Sans body, seafoam/jade palette with marigold/tangerine accents, glassmorphic hotspots, pill geometry

nodes.label: sampleCatalog honesty gate
nodes.rationale: Invented SKUs must not be badged 'IN-STORE: ROURKELA'; while sampleCatalog=true badges read 'AVAILABLE IN STORE*' and footer carries a preview-catalog line

nodes.label: WhatsApp enquiry conversion engine
nodes.rationale: Every product deep-links to wa.me with a prefilled message; the only outbound action besides GPS directions

nodes.label: 180KB first-load budget on 2G/3G
nodes.rationale: Target ₹8,000 Android on 2G/3G: ≤180KB gzipped JS+CSS, Lighthouse mobile ≥95×4, zero CLS

nodes.label: Product Launch Video Brief
nodes.rationale: Hyperframes chosen over Remotion as the primary engine because HTML composition added enough value that Remotion was deferred unless a motion-graphics beat demands it
